description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM rubber mounts which secure the Transfer Case / T-Case to the Brackets.
They bolt directly between the Bracket and the Transfer Case.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Mount
Qty 1 – RH Front Mount
Qty 1 – LH Front Mount
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
